description: A link that opens Bluu on the right screen — for "where do I…?", for anything better seen than read (charts, the full list, simulations), and for what is only done in Bluu (scanning a receipt, settings, devices, deleting). Ask with `question` in the user's words, or name a `screen`.

question.description: What the user wants to find or do, in their words, e.g. "set up widgets".

screen.description: A screen, when you already know which.

name: open_in_bluu
title: Open in Bluu
